description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzShareAPI class, which provides API endpoints for creating, deleting, and updating 'buzz share' entities in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for sharing posts, editing shares, and deleting shares, leveraging various traits and external DAO services.

classes.name: BuzzShareAPI
classes.description: API controller class providing endpoints for sharing, updating, and deleting BuzzShare entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Unimplemented method to retrieve all buzz shares; raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Unimplemented method for validation rules for getAll; raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new BuzzShare (sharing a post), setting related properties, and saving through DAO.

methods.name: setBuzzShareText
methods.description: Sets the text content of a BuzzShare object from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new BuzzShare, requiring shareId and optional text.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzShare identified by ID, with transaction management and permission checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a BuzzShare by ID.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Unimplemented method to retrieve a single BuzzShare; raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Unimplemented method for validation rules for getOne; raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing BuzzShare or BuzzFeedPost, with permission checks, transactional integrity, and returning the updated model.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the class type of the model to return based on a query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a BuzzShare, including optional text and model parameters.
